counterexample: INSERT INTO Drinker (name, address) VALUES ('D1', 'A1'); INSERT INTO Bar (name, address) VALUES ('B1', 'A1'); INSERT INTO Frequents (drinker, bar, times_a_week) VALUES ('D1', 'B1', 10);
explanation: Q1 checks if a bar serves 5 or more different beers. Q2 checks if a drinker frequents a bar at least as many times a week as the total number of times that drinker frequents all bars.
counterexample_dsp: A drinker who frequents a bar 10 times a week, but no other bars, will pass Q2 but fail Q1.
